goal: Define a project-wide error handling strategy for Bitcoin Core
Resolve repeated debates across validation and subsystem reviews on handling errors and defects
agreement: Concept approval for having a unified error handling strategy (sedited, josibake, willcl-ark)
Unaddressed objection: contradicts existing util::Expected practice and adds tech debt (ajtowns)
Unaddressed objection: broad exceptions introduce deadlock risks during shutdown (maflcko)
Objection: aborting on defects risks wallet corruption and node instability (furszy, mzumsande, stickies-v)
Objection: exceptions introduce unpredictable side effects and invisible control flow (l0rinc)

categories.name: docs
why: P2 because it provides needed architectural guidance for multiple open subsystem PRs
Saves developer time by resolving recurring debates over error handling patterns across the codebase
